caption:
A gift that gets opened once and worn for years.

Most gifts get used up. A jewelry gift is the one she keeps reaching for, and every time she does, it carries a little of the person who chose it.

Every piece in this post was made at our bench this year: a white diamond starburst, a black diamond ring in rose gold, a marquise in white gold, and one customer's ring photographed where she wears it.

Made to order pieces take up to 10 business days before they ship. If it's a holiday gift, start the conversation early.

Not sure what she would love? DM us. A real person answers.

caption:
Before it becomes a ring, it's a stone between two tweezers, turning in the light.

Many of our pieces start exactly like this at the bench: one stone, looked at from every side, until it's clear what it should become.

That's how custom jewelry should begin. Have a stone, an idea or a story you want to wear? DM us and we'll design around it.

caption:
The second ring has a harder job than the first.

A wedding band sits right next to the engagement ring for years. It has to follow its shape, match or answer its gold, and still look good on its own.

Here are bands from our bench and from our customers: a stack built around an engagement ring, two bands in two golds, a white diamond eternity band, a yellow gold band with a heart-cut diamond, and Starz from REMNANT.

Already have the engagement ring? DM us a photo and we'll design the wedding band around it.
